summary: Both session plugins dial NATS through one new envoy-client function with pingInterval 10 s and maxPingOut 2 (a frozen path is left within 30 s, 52 s when the first redial also hangs), every registration sends plugin and plugin_version which the listener stores and lists, and stall-proxy tests on a real natsd and listener prove the reconnect and #2228's catch-up for envoy-client, Oh My Pi and Claude Code. The branch stacks on sjawhar/legion#2228 and merges only after it.

decisions.decision: pingInterval 10000 ms, maxPingOut 2; dial timeout (20 s) and reconnectTimeWait (2 s) unchanged
decisions.reason: nats.js 2.29.3 heartbeats.js drops a connection on the tick that finds maxPingOut pings unanswered, so a freeze is noticed within 3 x 10 s = 30 s; a redial that also hangs adds 20 + 2 s = 52 s < 60 s; 15 s would give 67 s. Lowering timeout would also shorten the first connect on a slow tailnet.

decisions.decision: One exported envoy-client function natsConnectionOptions (subpath @legion/envoy-client/nats-connection) used by both plugins
decisions.reason: The options are duplicated at pi-envoy/extensions/envoy.ts:977-986 and claude-envoy/src/envoy-channel-server.ts:1490-1497; INFRA-552's measurement job must dial with the same values.

decisions.decision: Registration fields plugin (npm package name) and plugin_version; Claude Code reports its plugin-cache directory's version segment (the 12-character marketplace commit) or 'source'; Oh My Pi and OpenCode report package.json version; SubscribeInput.plugin required; Go fields omitempty
decisions.reason: claude-envoy package.json 1.0.0 is never bumped and Claude Code versions the plugin by marketplace commit (claude-envoy README 'Updates'); pi-envoy's release inlines the released version; numbers overlap across plugins so the name is needed; an older plugin's entry then shows neither field.

decisions.decision: PR base main, branch stacked on legion/INFRA-439 by forward merges; the architect does not accept and the merger does not build READY until #2228 has merged and its squash commit is in the branch
decisions.reason: Spec 'Order: build on #2228 (merge after it)'; a base of legion/INFRA-439 would carry none of main's required checks; the repository squash-merges and deletes merged branches.

decisions.decision: New CI job envoy-session-stall with Go and LEGION_E2E_ENVOY_STACK=1 runs the three stall suites; existing pi-envoy, claude-envoy and envoy-client jobs keep their filters and skip them
decisions.reason: The tests need go build of natsd and the listener; the pi-envoy and claude-envoy jobs have no Go, and widening their filters to packages/envoy/** would run them on every Dispatch change.

findings.finding: The 60 s bound has no stated start, end or treatment of new connections during the stall; detection is up to (maxPingOut+1) x pingInterval and a hung redial adds the 20 s dial timeout.
findings.answer: Start = proxy freeze; end = the first connection opened after the freeze that forwards a SUB (recorded by the proxy, so it works for the out-of-process Claude Code server) plus a live delivery on it. New connections forward (a Tailscale Service routes a new flow to a live pod); row B stalls the first redial. Arithmetic in decision 1: 30 s, 52 s with one hung redial.

findings.finding: A proxy that stops reading could leave nats.js's stale close waiting on a full send buffer.
findings.answer: The proxy reads and discards both sides of a frozen connection and never closes either.

findings.finding: The missed message could arrive through a heartbeat sweep while NATS is still frozen, proving nothing about the reconnect; role messages are not stored.
findings.answer: Stall tests set ENVOY_HEARTBEAT_MS to 240000 so the reconnect is the only sweep trigger in the window; the message is a direct message to the session id; the test asserts the replay suffix on it and no suffix on a message sent after the reconnect.

findings.finding: 'Plugin version' is undefined for Claude Code (1.0.0 never bumped, versioned by marketplace commit) and for source runs; the value must name the plugin; OpenCode also registers.
findings.answer: Decision 3: plugin + plugin_version; Claude Code reports the plugin-cache version segment or 'source'; pi-envoy and OpenCode report package.json version; the move's rule is written into the docs.

findings.finding: Old listener drops new fields; old plugins send none; envoy-client's zod schema strips unknown keys.
findings.answer: Go fields omitempty with a test that a body without them lists neither key; SessionWireSchema gains optional fields; the listener rollout before the move is reported to the architect as INFRA-14's sequencing.

findings.finding: pi-envoy and claude-envoy CI jobs have no Go, no NATS and no LEGION_E2E; their filters miss packages/envoy; tests must fail, not skip, when the gate is set but Go is missing; Bun's 5 s default timeout.
findings.answer: Task 5's dedicated job and filter; the stack helper throws when the gate is set and Go is missing; 120 s per-test timeout.

findings.finding: Shorter pings raise spurious reconnects, and a role message inside such a gap is lost until INFRA-547.
findings.answer: Accepted in decision 1: a pong may take 20-30 s; every reconnect runs the catch-up; stale-disconnect logging left out of scope.
